decision: Is this company worth partnering with, is the agreement written before work starts, and should we run it again?
limitations: Give {check, input} for scorePartner, checkTerms or reviewPartnership; with no input you get a labelled demo. Unknown checks, top-level fields and fields inside input stop the run.
The score is a rubric of your own 0-3 ratings, not a prediction. It cannot know whether the partner will promote as promised, and inputs you list as unknowns are noted but do not lower the score.
checkTerms checks that each of the five terms is present, not what it says; any entry passes.

"Do it again" needs a qualified lead, pipeline, a full sales cycle elapsed and at least 20% of sign-ups qualified. Pipeline before a full cycle reads "Too early to decide"; a thin audience reads "Change the format".
review: The partnership owner checks the overlap and reach ratings against the partner's own data, and both sides sign the lead-sharing and consent terms, before work starts. The review is judged on pipeline after a full sales cycle.
